feature: Anti-anchoring: per-production-file hypothesis coverage requirement in HypothesisEngine
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT includes a coverage requirement: at least 1 hypothesis per production source file (*.java, *.py, *.scala, *.go, *.ts, *.js) OR explicit SKIP with justification. Doc/test/config-only commits exempt.

AC-2: Targeted rerun of 2213f71944ae, 409664582f53, dd6f9ba60fb4 via run_eval.py --commit-ids: ≥1/3 improves D3 by ≥0.25 vs frozen iter-3-n20-v2 baselines {2213f71944ae: 0.0, 409664582f53: 0.0, dd6f9ba60fb4: 0.0}. Judge config must match iter-3-n20-v2 (cursor-sdk/claude-sonnet-4-6, fix-diff fallback per FIX-JUDGE-INFRA).

AC-3: Re-run the 10 clean commits from iter-3-n20-v2 (output/runs/2026-06-11_02-04-45_real_n20/investigations/* where buggy_label=false) via run_eval.py --commit-ids; zero reclassifications to HIGH or CRITICAL (iter-3-n20-v2 baseline: all 10 were MEDIUM).

AC-4: Fresh 12-commit regression panel re-run (6 buggy + 6 clean per tests/test_panel_script_gate.py header); buggy_recall ≥ 0.80 (≥5/6 buggy → HIGH/CRITICAL after risk_policy). test_panel_script_gate.py must still pass (risk_policy unchanged).
AC-5: D6 ≥ 0.70 on frozen n=5 smoke via run_eval.py --commit-ids f897d46870ba 90846b586c51 2213f71944ae 409664582f53 dd6f9ba60fb4; mean D6 across 5 ≥ 0.70.
AC-6: Total HYPOTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT length stays ≤ 60 lines (regression guard from iter-3e; enforced by test_hypothesis_engine.py::test_prompt_length_at_most_60_lines).
edge_cases: EC-1: The coverage requirement must NOT inject file names, risk labels, or rubric tiers into the prompt (consistent with iter-3e hygiene). Files list should come from context, not system prompt.

EC-2: For commits with only 1 production file (e.g. 409664582f53), the per-file requirement degenerates to ≥1 hypothesis with file field set to that production path; verified by unit test on single-file context fixture.

EC-3: If the targeted rerun shows ΔD3=0 for all 3 commits, record decision anti-anchoring-insufficient in .harness/evals/eval-iter-2d-wrong-mechanism.json and close task with negative result documented.
EC-4: The new COVERAGE REQUIREMENT section must be ≤ 8 lines to respect prompt brevity constraints.
verification_method: 1. ruff check + pytest (300+ tests must pass). 2. AC-1/EC-1/EC-4: grep + test_hypothesis_engine coverage-section tests. 3. AC-2: run_eval.py --commit-ids 2213f71944ae 409664582f53 dd6f9ba60fb4; score D3 vs frozen baselines with same judge. 4. AC-3: run_eval.py --commit-ids on 10 clean prefixes from iter-3-n20-v2 run dir; assert risk_level ∉ {HIGH, CRITICAL}. 5. AC-4: run_eval.py --commit-ids on 12 panel prefixes; compute buggy_recall; pytest tests/test_panel_script_gate.py. 6. AC-5: run_eval.py --commit-ids on frozen n=5 set; mean D6 ≥ 0.70. 7. EC-3: document outcome in eval report regardless of PASS/FAIL on AC-2.
